title: Reject unsupported DWG HATCH/MPOLYGON edge entity types
authority: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 §20.4.75, printed page 195 defines four non-polyline HATCH edge types: line, circular arc, elliptic arc and spline.
problem: The preflight accepted any DRW_Line or DRW_Spline subtype. RAY and HELIX inputs were accepted and silently encoded as LINE and SPLINE, losing the ray semantics and helix-specific turns/radius. Other built-in line-derived entities could likewise be silently projected.
sample: The locally authored AC1021 writer probe used a RAY (base 3,4; direction 4,0), and a HELIX with degree-2 control spline, turns=4, radius=2. Both files include existing default material/plotstyle opt-ins and a following LINE. LibreDWG 0.14 decoded HATCH curve types 1 and 4 respectively; ODA File Converter produced AC1027 DXF with LineEdge and SplineEdge, no .err, zero-byte log, and no ezdxf 1.4.5 audit errors/fixes. DXFs are manually paired with the recorded converter run; the artifact hashes do not authenticate converter lineage.
change: Validate public eType as LINE, ARC, ELLIPSE, or SPLINE and require the corresponding dynamic cast. On LINE reject known built-in ELLIPSE, 3DLINE, RAY, TRACE, TEXT and IMAGE families even when relabelled; on SPLINE reject HELIX even when relabelled. Encoder dispatch uses the selected type tag. Existing consumer subclasses of supported types remain allowed under their declared base contract; their additional custom semantics are not independently validated.
coverage: Across AC1015/18/21/24/27/32, direct HATCH and MPOLYGON tests refuse RAY, XLINE, 3DLINE, TRACE, TEXT, IMAGE, HELIX, incompatible dynamic/tag combinations, null, and every built-in descendant relabelled to LINE or SPLINE, before body/text/handle buffers and bit cursors, handle or object type change. Same object retries corrected LINE successfully. LINE/ARC/ELLIPSE/SPLINE and ordinary custom LINE/SPLINE subclasses remain accepted; direct boundary helper dispatch obeys the tag. HATCH facade rejects all variants then retries and native readback finds a single HATCH plus following LINE. MPOLYGON controls exercise direct encoding, not a physical output or facade claim.
validation: ctest --test-dir /private/tmp/ac1021-hatch-edges/snapshot-build -R ^libdxfrw_dwg_hatch_edge_subtype$ --output-on-failure passes 1/1; unmodified 5a9c63a3 fails the same test.
Integrated subtype and ellipse-edge tests passed 2/2. The integrated subtype test also seeds partial bits and checks byte contents and bit positions after refusal.
